evidence: The authors have investigated a liquid alkoxide, aluminum tri- sec-butoxide (ATSB), as a precursor for ALD deposition of alumina. ... XPS analysis confirms the stoichiometric deposition of Al2O3 with carbon contamination below XPS detection limits (about 0.5 at. %) when an oxygen plasma was applied and only 1 –2 at. % carbon for low-temperature H2O-based thermal processes.
